sousTitres.appareils: Apple Health, Health Connect, Strava, Garmin…
sousTitres.preferences: Training, nutrition, coaching style, notifications, language

objectifs.sansEcheance: Your goal has no date to set.
objectifs.aideEcheance: Your main competition (priority A) follows this date.
objectifs.videTexte: Add a competition: your plan will be built around it.

disponibilites.aide: Tap a time of day to add or remove it, then tap the slot to set its duration and place.
disponibilites.aucune: No slot: the coach will pick default days.
disponibilites.lieuxRetires: A deleted place was removed from your slots (“Anywhere”): save to confirm.

lieux.videTexte: Add where you train: the coach adapts exercises to the equipment available.
lieux.villeAide: Used for the weather of outdoor sessions.
lieux.confirmerTexte: This place won't be suggested anymore. Your past sessions don't change.

abonnement.achatsBientot: Subscriptions and purchases are coming soon to the app.

appareils.texte: Soon, your watches and health apps will send your sleep, heart rate and workouts to the coach. Nothing is connected yet.

preferences.varieteAide: 1: always the same exercises · 5: lots of changes
preferences.allergiesAide: Health data: saved only with your consent.
preferences.allergiesSansAccord: To enter your allergies and intolerances, first give your consent for health data.
preferences.checkinAide: In the morning, if you haven't done your check-in.
preferences.heuresCalmesAide: No reminders between these two times.
preferences.langueAide: The app's and the coach's texts switch to this language.

sante.sansAccordTexte: Without your consent for health data, Athlenis neither shows nor saves your injuries and pain.
sante.signaler: New pain? Report it at check-in or to the coach.

memoire.intro: The coach remembers what you tell it to adapt your sessions. You can correct, confirm, disable or erase each item.
memoire.santeMasquee: Items about your health are hidden until you give your consent for health data.
memoire.videTexte: Through your chats and sessions, the coach will remember your preferences, constraints and goals.
memoire.confirmerTexte: It will be permanently deleted: the coach won't remember it anymore.

donnees.exportTexte: An archive with everything Athlenis knows about you: profile, sessions, check-ins, messages, consents.
donnees.enPreparation: Export requested on {{date}}: being prepared. You'll also get the link by email.
donnees.pret: Your export is ready (link valid until {{date}}).
donnees.expire: The link to your last export has expired.
donnees.suppressionTexte: Your account and all your data are permanently erased. This can't be undone.
donnees.etape1Liste: This erases: your profile, your plans and sessions, your check-ins, your messages to the coach, what the coach remembers, your places, availability and consents.
donnees.etape1Abonnement: A subscription paid on the App Store or Google Play must be stopped from your phone: deleting your account doesn't cancel it.
donnees.etape1Export: Export your data first if you want to keep it.
donnees.etape2Texte: Your account will be permanently deleted and you'll be signed out.
donnees.fictif: Demo mode: your account won't really be deleted, you'll only be signed out.
donnees.erreurSuppression: Deletion failed. Your account is intact: try again.
donnees.erreurSuppressionIncertaine: No response from the server: the deletion couldn't be confirmed. Try again; if your account is already deleted, you'll simply be signed out.
donnees.supprimeSansDeconnexion: Your account is deleted, but signing out failed on this phone. Tap “Sign me out”.
